title: TEOS Institution Profile
description: Machine-readable contract for versioned institution-owned identity, presentation, scheduling conventions, templates, and integration configuration. An Institution Profile supplies local context but never modifies or contains curriculum.

institution_profile_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Institution Profile namespace.

version.description: The version of this coherent institutional configuration set.

institution_information.description: The authoritative identity, display name, owner, and time zone of the institution.

campus_information.description: Optional campus or site context subordinate to the institution identity.

campus_identifier.description: The institution-governed identifier of the campus or site.

display_name.description: The approved campus or site display name.

address.description: The approved presentation form of the campus address.

branding.description: Approved brand characteristics and accessibility conventions; binary assets remain separate.

colors.description: Approved named brand colors expressed as six-digit hexadecimal RGB values.

typography.description: Approved typography guidance expressed without embedding fonts or templates.

logo_references.description: Version-bound references to separately owned logo assets.

template_references.description: Compatible, version-bound template selections by artifact, audience, campus, or destination.

academic_calendar_references.description: One or more compatible, version-bound Academic Calendars.

meeting_patterns.description: Institution-owned recurring delivery containers that constrain Session placement without becoming curriculum structure.

instructional_time_conventions.description: Local definitions governing how meeting time is interpreted for scheduling.

breaks_count_as_instructional_time.description: Whether scheduled breaks count toward instructional time.

rounding_increment.description: The local duration increment used when allocating instructional time.

theory_convention.description: The institution-owned convention for theory delivery time.

lab_convention.description: The institution-owned convention for lab delivery time.

holiday_references.description: Calendar classifications or institution-owned policies for handling holidays and closures; this collection contains no dates.

header_definitions.description: Approved institutional header content applied through templates and renderers.

footer_definitions.description: Approved institutional footer content applied through templates and renderers.

terminology_overrides.description: Presentation-only mappings from canonical TEOS terms to institution-approved display labels.

audience.description: The audience for which the override applies.

lms_settings.description: Non-secret LMS destination mappings and compatibility configuration.

export_settings.description: Approved artifact, format, mapping, packaging, and accessibility configuration.

local_policy_references.description: Versioned or citable institution-owned policy references.

composition.description: Explicit profile composition and precedence with provenance for each contributing profile.

profile_references.description: Version-bound institution-wide or campus profile components.

precedence.description: A deterministic ordered list of profile identifiers from lowest to highest precedence.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this profile.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Institution Profile.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

recurrence.default: Every eligible weekday while the selected Academic Calendar is instructional.

institutionInformation.title: Institution Information
institutionInformation.description: Authoritative institution identity and operating context.

institution_identifier.description: The authoritative identifier assigned to the institution.

owner.description: The organization authoritative for the profile.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone governing institutional operations.

contact_information.description: Approved institution contact information for presentation.

meetingPattern.title: Meeting Pattern
meetingPattern.description: A permitted recurring institutional delivery container.

meeting_pattern_id.description: A stable identifier unique within this Institution Profile.

title.description: The approved name of the meeting pattern.

time_zone.description: The time zone in which the pattern is interpreted.

eligible_weekdays.description: The weekdays on which the meeting pattern may occur.

start_time.description: The local start time for the delivery container.

end_time.description: The local end time for the delivery container.

instructional_duration.description: The instructional duration available within the delivery container.

compatible_session_types.description: Canonical Session types compatible with the meeting pattern.

templateSelection.title: Template Selection
templateSelection.description: A version-bound template and the context in which it may be selected.

artifact_type.description: The artifact type for which the template is approved.

audience.description: The audience constraint for this template selection.

destination.description: The destination constraint for this template selection.

lmsSettings.title: LMS Settings
lmsSettings.description: Non-secret configuration for LMS mappings and compatibility.

packaging_profile.description: The non-secret identifier of the approved packaging profile.

exportSettings.title: Export Settings
exportSettings.description: Approved output and destination configuration that does not change source meaning.

accessibility_requirements.description: Accessibility requirements applicable to exported artifacts.
